serviceDetails.description: This online service can be used to apply for subsidies to offset the cost of child care for eligible families.

sections.title: Personal information
sections.content:
Personal information the service may maintain for you includes:
  • Name
  • Date of birth
  • Citizenship status
  • Social insurance number
  • Telephone number
  • Mailing address
  • Physical address
  • Indigenous status
  • Employer name
  • Employer phone number
  • Co-applicant (other parent's) information
  • Household income and finances
  • Children's information
  • Child care program information

sections.title: How is personal data being used
sections.content: The information is used to determine eligibility and subsidy rates for providing subsidized childcare to Albertans who need it.

sections.title: Legislation
sections.content:
The following are the legal authorities that authorize this service to collect your personal information:
Section 33 (c) of the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act
